candidates.status: git available but current folder is not a repo
candidates.value: Make every autonomous/promotion change reviewable, reversible and branch/worktree isolated.
candidates.next_step: Add /git-guard and optional git worktree validation before live promotion.

candidates.name: Docker validation backend
candidates.value: Validate copied workspaces and proposed patches without touching the live tree.
candidates.next_step: Keep Docker as the main patch simulation backend and add profile history/GUI review.

candidates.name: Pre-commit release hooks
candidates.value: Run a consistent local gate before promotion: syntax, formatting, static checks and tests.

candidates.name: Ruff lint/format
candidates.value: Fast Python linting catches unused imports, obvious bugs and style drift before Docker tests.
candidates.next_step: Add optional /ruff-check and include it in release-gate when available.

candidates.name: Playwright browser smoke tests
candidates.value: Catch Send-button and JavaScript UI failures through real browser interaction, not just static JS parsing.
candidates.next_step: Add a browser smoke test for sending chat, toggling tabs and Docker panel buttons.

candidates.name: Defensive security status
candidates.value: Inventory Windows Defender/AVG-style tooling, firewall state, listening ports and Nova/Docker lab context before security work.
candidates.next_step: Run /security-status before lab/security tasks and include the report in release checklist context.

candidates.name: Mypy type checking
candidates.value: Find interface drift between modules as Nova grows.
candidates.next_step: Start with a relaxed mypy profile for new modules only, then expand.

candidates.name: Semgrep security/static rules
candidates.value: Find risky subprocess, unsafe path handling, injection-prone strings and weak validation gates.
candidates.next_step: Add optional semgrep scan profile to /release-gate.

candidates.name: uv environment manager
candidates.value: Faster, reproducible Python environment setup and lockfile-based dependency installs.
candidates.next_step: Add optional /env-doctor checks for uv and requirements drift.

candidates.name: ripgrep code search
candidates.value: Faster codebase scans and bug triage than recursive Python text scans.
candidates.next_step: Use rg automatically in codebase scans when present, fallback to Python otherwise.
